heading: Sec. 1.01.010. - Designation and citation.
text:
The ordinances embraced in this and the following chapters and sections shall constitute
and be designated the "Reno Municipal Code" and may be so cited.

(Code 1966, § 1.01.010)

Charter reference—
Codification authority, § 2.120.

State Law reference—
Codification authority, NRS 268.014.

heading: Sec. 1.01.020. - Definitions.
text:
The following definitions shall be observed unless it shall be otherwise expressly
provided in any section or unless inconsistent with the manifest intent of the city
council or unless the context clearly requires otherwise:

(1)

"Board of health" shall mean the county district board of health.

(2)

"Charter" is deemed to mean and refer to the Charter of Reno, Nevada.

(3)

"City" means the city of Reno, in the State of Nevada.

(4)

"Code" shall mean the Reno Municipal Code, as amended.

(5)

"Council" means the city council consisting off six (6) councilmembers and a mayor of the city.
"All its members" or "all councilmembers" mean the total number of councilmembers
and the mayor as provided for by the Charter of Reno, Nevada.

(6)

"County" shall mean Washoe County, Nevada.

(7)

"Health department" shall mean the county district health department of the board of health.

(8)

"Health officers" shall mean the county district health officer or health administrator of the board
of health or their designee.

(9)

"Person" includes a corporation, firm, partnership, association, as well as individuals. It
shall also include an executor, administrator, trustee, receiver or other representative
appointed according to law.

(10)

"Public officer" as used in this Code shall mean a person elected or appointed to a position which
is created by the Charter or ordinance.

(11)

"May" is permissive.

(12)

"Must" and "shall." Each is mandatory.

(13)

"NRS." The abbreviation "NRS" shall mean the Nevada Revised Statutes, as amended.

(14)

"Officers, departments, board, and commission." Except as otherwise specifically provided, whenever any officer, department, board,
commission or their agency is referred to by title alone, such reference shall be
construed as if followed by the words "of the City of Reno, Nevada." Whenever in accordance
with the provisions of this Code any specific act is required to be done by any designated
officer or official of the city, such act may be performed by any duly authorized
member of his department.

(15)

"Or, and." "Or" may read "and," and "and" may be read "or" if the sense requires it.

(16)

"State." The word "the state" or "this state" shall be construed to mean the State of Nevada.

(Code 1966, § 1.04.020)

heading: Sec. 1.01.030. - Grammatical interpretation.
text:
The following grammatical rules shall apply in the ordinances of the city:

(1)

Gender. When any subject matter, party or person is described or referred to by words importing
the masculine, female as well as males, and associations and bodies corporate as well
as individuals, shall be deemed to be included.

(2)

Singular and plural. The singular number includes the plural and the plural includes the singular.

(3)

Tenses. Words used in the present tense include the past and the future tenses and vice versa,
unless manifestly inapplicable.

(4)

Use of words and phrases. Words and phrases not specifically defined shall be construed according to the context
and approved usage of the language.

(Code 1966, § 1.04.050)
